summary: Three questions with sub-parts, each opening with a quotation or a short brand scenario. Q1 has three 4-mark parts that ask you to apply a named framework (marketing myopia, BCG Matrix, Ansoff Matrix) with examples. Q2 has two 6-mark parts on consumer behaviour. Q3 is a 6-mark case on global marketing strategy. Almost every part says 'evaluate' or 'critically evaluate' and asks for examples.
paper_format: MST Fall 2026 (3 Sep 2026): 3 questions with sub-parts, all compulsory, attempt sequentially. Q1 (a, b, c) 3 x 4 = 12; Q2 (a, b) 2 x 6 = 12; Q3 (i, ii) 6.
question_verbs: Evaluate the statement in the context of
Evaluate each stage ... with a suitable example
marks_structure: 4-mark framework application: explain the concept or the relevant cells, then a strategy and an example for each
6-mark consumer behaviour: name the theory, explain how it works in the scenario, evaluate
6-mark case: compare the strategies in the case, the factors behind each, then a 'what if' evaluation
repeated_topics: Marketing myopia and changing customer needs
Standardization, localization and glocalization in global marketing
sources: Photos of the printed MST paper, MK5201, Fall 2026 (3 Sep 2026), 2 pages
